annotations.title: Change a value a card lets the person set

description: Changes the cell a Glance card names in its set column (get_glance shows it as set, like 'Goals'!B2), when the person tells you the new value: a goal, an amount per month, a balance. Only cells a card names can be changed, never a formula, and the value must fit the cell (its dropdown, a number, a date as YYYY-MM-DD). Called without value it says what the cell holds now and what it takes. Gives back what the cards show after.

cell.description: The card's set cell, as get_glance gives it.

value.description: The new value: text, a number, true or false. Leave out to read the cell.
